body:
Assumptions: 12% cost of equity, exit P/E of 15 in year 10, and the company's own payout ratio. The question is what 10-year EPS CAGR the current P/E implies.

| | P/E (recomputed) | Implied 10-yr EPS CAGR |
|---|---|---|
| Uniparts | 16.7 | **~9%** |
| MPS | 20.2 | ~11.5% |
| Rolex Rings (reported / ex-one-offs) | 28.9 / ~24 | ~19.6% / ~17.4% |
| (Banco, for reference) | 19.4 | ~11% |
